subject: website
name: Fluux Messenger
summary: An XMPP chat client, built from upstream's open source (AGPL) at a pinned commit. Every script ships in its own files, so no external code runs: Level 3. Not Level 4: the XMPP server the user signs in to holds the account and delivers every message, and attachments live on its upload host, so the app relies on a server, though XMPP is open and the user can pick or run their own. Keys and history stay on this computer. Not private: the server sees your IP address and who talks to whom.

operations.name: Send and receive messages
operations.note: The code does what it promises. With OpenPGP turned on the server cannot read the text, but it sees who talks to whom and when, and can withhold delivery.

operations.name: Your account and contacts
operations.note: Held by the XMPP server you sign in to, which can suspend or remove it.

operations.name: Send and receive attachments
operations.note: Uploaded to and downloaded from the server's HTTP upload host. Encrypted attachments are decrypted on this computer; the host still sees your IP address and the file's size.

operations.name: Keep OpenPGP keys, account and history
operations.note: Stored in this site's browser storage on this computer. Not private: the stored account name is the one the server knows.

connections.name: XMPP server (WebSocket, and its host-meta file)
connections.note: The server named at sign-in. Rooms, contacts and history come from it and are trusted as given. It sees your IP address.

connections.name: HTTP upload host
connections.note: The host the server advertises for attachments. Used only when you send or open an attachment.
